title: The Kindly Portrait
author: Rafael Lockridge
blurb: Beatrix Marchetti, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
